title: probing-leadtime-autoscaler-and-utilization-stitcher
author: Maya Patel
description: Motivation: Dedicated fleets show variable cold-start/ramp lead times across zones and GPU types. Existing autoscalers use a fixed margin and conservative cooldowns which either wastes reserved capacity or causes brief throughput drops during scale-ups. This PR introduces a probing-based lead-time autoscaler and a complementary utilization stitcher to smooth tenant throughput guarantees during scaling transitions. Summary: - Add a lightweight probing probe that issues low-overhead synthetic probes to new nodes to measure true request warmup latency and effective throughput ramp curve per-node-type/zone. - Use observed lead-time distributions to compute an adaptive scale-up window and pro-rated reservation commit that guarantees tenant throughput while minimizing warm idle GPUs. - Introduce a Utilization Stitcher service that stitches historical per-tenant utilization with live probe-based short-term forecasts so we can emit smoother per-tenant throughput reports and credit reconciliations. - Wire telemetry: new metrics (autoscaler.probe_leadtime_p50/p90, autoscaler.probe_success_rate, utilstitcher/tenant_smoothed_util_p95) and an exporter to the centralized SLO metrics pipeline. - Add operator-facing knobs: probe_frequency, probe_concurrency_cap, leadtime_tail_factor, stitcher_lookback_seconds. Checklist: - [x] Core probing implementation - pkg/autoscaler/leadtime_probe.go - [x] Adaptive scale decision logic - pkg/autoscaler/decider.go - [x] Utilization stitcher and reporting - cmd/telemetry/tenant_util_stitcher.go - [x] Unit + integration tests - tests/autoscaler/probe_integration_test.go - [x] Helm values and operator docs - charts/dedicated/values.yaml, docs/operator/scale-tuning.md Changes in behavior and rationale: - Autoscaler now uses empirical lead-time statistics (p50/p90) per node type to create a ramp policy instead of a single global ramp constant. This reduces over-provisioning for fast-start GPUs and tightens SLA degradation during slow starts. - Utilization Stitcher smooths short windows where per-tenant util spikes while keeping long-term accounting identical; this reduces noisy credit churn during transient bursts. - Probes are capped and rate-limited to avoid causing capacity churn themselves; we also back off on probe failures. Implementation notes: - Probing is implemented as a best-effort synthetic request runner that exercises the full inference path but with throttled tokens and a small payload to approximate warmup cost. - Observations are recorded into a lightweight ring buffer per node-type and exported to Prometheus via histogram snapshots. - The decider computes a leadtime-adjusted reservation target R' = max(R, R * (1 + leadtime_tail_factor * estimated_p90 / nominal_leadtime)). Operational impact & rollout plan: - Feature is gated behind an operator flag (autoscaler.enable_probe_leadtime=false by default). - Rollout plan: opt-in on a few non-critical Dedicated pools for 2 weeks, monitor autoscaler.probe_success_rate and tenant_smoothed_util p95 stability. - If metrics look stable, flip default to enabled for fleets using GPU family v2+ after a canary. Related: Linear ENG-8421 (probe design), ENG-8473 (stitcher reporting). Also references an internal incident SUP-9123 where a fleet experienced a throughput gap during a 5x scale-up. Migration & backward compatibility: - When disabled, autoscaler behaves exactly as before. - Metrics names are additive; dashboards should ignore absent metrics until the feature is enabled. Testing: - Unit tests for probe result aggregation and decider math. - Integration test simulates a 3-zone scale-up and asserts no >5% throughput gap for committed tenants while reducing average warm idle by >=12% compared to baseline. Docs & operator guidance: - docs/operator/scale-tuning.md added with recommended defaults and troubleshooting steps. - Chart values include conservative defaults for probe_frequency and concurrency caps. Rollout notes: - Merged via squash. - Post-merge: enable telemetry export only after a config flag is set in staging to avoid noisy metrics on prod.

review_conversation: Andre: Can probes impact SLAs if they spike? Reply: Probes are throttled and use a small payload; we've also added a global concurrency cap and backoff on failures. Elena: Why not use historical traces instead of synthetic probes? Reply: Historical traces under-report cold-start behaviour because they conflate warm and probe-avoiding traffic; probes give a controlled signal that captures full warmup path. Tom: Suggest adding a safety knob to disable probing per-pool. Reply: Added pool-level gate and helm value. Andre: Tests look good but add a test for probe backoff. Reply: Added probe backoff integration test. Approvals: Andre (approved), Elena (approved), Tom (approved with comments resolved).

release_notes: Introduce a probing-based lead-time autoscaler and utilization stitcher to reduce overprovisioning and smooth tenant throughput during scale events. Feature is opt-in behind autoscaler.enable_probe_leadtime. Adds new telemetry metrics for lead-time and smoothed utilization.
